en.headline: Hysan first-half underlying profit rises 7.4% on residential sales gains
en.dek: The Causeway Bay landlord reported underlying profit of HK$1.11 billion and declared an unchanged first interim dividend of 27 cents per share.
body: Hysan Development on Thursday reported underlying profit of HK$1.11 billion for the six months ended 30 June, up 7.4 per cent from a year earlier, driven mainly by fair-value gains from the sale of residential units at its Bamboo Grove project.

Turnover was largely flat at HK$1.73 billion. Recurring underlying profit rose 1.7 per cent to HK$1.05 billion. The board declared a first interim dividend of 27 HK cents per share, unchanged from the same period last year.

Retail revenue increased 1.4 per cent, with the Hong Kong portfolio occupancy reaching 96 per cent. Office revenue was mixed, with the local portfolio slightly lower while the Shanghai portfolio showed stronger occupancy. Chairwoman Irene Lee said the multi-year rejuvenation of the Lee Gardens precinct had entered a large-scale harvest phase, citing expanded luxury flagship stores.
The company said its five-year HK$8 billion capital recycling programme had already realised about HK$4.5 billion through residential disposals, more than halfway to the target.

zh.headline: 希慎上半年基本溢利升7.4% 派中期息27仙
zh.dek: 受惠出售竹林苑住宅單位公平值收益，基本溢利11.07億元，第一次中期息維持每股27仙。
body: 希慎興業周四公布截至6月30日止六個月業績，基本溢利11.07億元，按年升7.4%，主要受惠於出售竹林苑住宅單位的公平值收益。
營業額大致持平於17.28億元，經常性基本溢利升1.7%至10.49億元。董事會宣派第一次中期股息每股27仙，與去年同期相同。
商舖業務營業額升1.4%，香港組合出租率達96%。寫字樓方面本地組合略為回落，上海組合出租率則明顯改善。主席利蘊蓮表示，利園區多年優化工程已進入大規模收成階段，奢華品牌旗艦店擴建帶動表現。
集團五年80億元資本循環計劃已透過出售住宅項目回收約45億元，完成目標逾半。
